feeds.title: Remodelista
feeds.description: With obsessively curated remodeling guides, daily design dispatches, and ideas for every room, Remodelista is the definitive sourcebook for your considered home. We're a group of friends with a collective design DNA and a mission to deliver a daily curated selection of stylish pieces and furnishings for your home.

feeds.title: Niche Interiors
feeds.description: Follow along as San Francisco Interior Design firm Niche Interiors shares decorating tips and local San Francisco finds. A San Francisco-based interior design firm offering a modern and sustainable approach to living spaces.

feeds.title: Julie Rootes Interiors News
feeds.description: Julie Rootes Interiors is a San Francisco Bay Area Interior Design Studio known for its determined attention to detail and ability to create rich spaces with beautiful fabrics and finishes that nonetheless stand up to the demands of real life. The founder, Julie Rootes personalizes her home designs with memorable colors, textures, and custom moments. Explore her decor tips, designs and more!

feeds.title: Kimball Starr Interior Design Blog
feeds.description: Kimball Starr is an award-winning interior design firm in San Francisco that delivers authentic and quality-based interiors. Since 2005, Kimball Starr Interior Design has been 'changing people's lives one room at a time' with a focus on transforming spaces into beautiful and intelligently planned interiors. Explore our blog to get design tips, inspiration, kitchen and bath designs, trends and more!

feeds.title: Coddington Design Blog
feeds.description: Visit our interior design blog to learn more about topics, trends, and more. Get inspired and learn how to elevate your space with our help! A Northern California native, interior designer Melanie Coddington founded Coddington Design in 2005. A full-service interior design firm, Coddington Design has become one of the most trusted interior design firms on the West Coast servicing a select clientele from Palo Alto to Los Angeles.

feeds.title: Susie Novak Interiors Blog
feeds.description: Susie Novak interiors is an interior design firm offering decorating and interior design services for modern and traditional homes in Oakland, Piedmont, Berkeley, San Francisco, and beyond. Stay up to date on interior designing trends, tips for DIT decor, inspirations and more!

feeds.title: Via D'sa Interior Design Blog
feeds.description: I'm Cheryl D'sa. My design expertise was developed while training with passionate residential and commercial Interior Designers & Lighting Designers who inspired and challenged my creative thinking. I have navigated the ins and outs of the design process coordinating with architects, contractors, vendors; the tribe that it takes to build successfully! Explore my blog and find helpful tidbits on interior designing to design your home as you envision.

feeds.title: Studio SHK Blog
feeds.description: Find Design inspiration from top interior design firm, Studio SHK. Studio SHK is committed to creative and functional design. We design site and client-specific, infusing a sense of playfulness and artistic expression to each project. As identity-designers, we seek to capture the inherent character of a place and the spirit of its inhabitants.
